quotes.text: // We want to avoid feeding already decoded output back through the decoder.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The message container routes encoded bytes through its decoder, but decoded bytes use mimeObjectClass.parse_buffer. The base buffer callback dispatches ordinary parse_line work, so the decoded data does not reenter MimeMessage_parse_buffer. Source comments name setup, consumption and EOF/finalizer cleanup and explain this distinction, as requested in review. Decoder selection still has an exact raw/save-as bypass. The fixture checks attachment metadata and nonemptiness, not every message rendering or save path. Required primary gaps keep full-audit credit at zero.
title: The message-container decoder callback deliberately bypasses its own override
